ADD THE BEST DEALS DIRECT CALCULATOR TO YOUR WEBSITE
=====================================================

1. Unzip this file. You get a folder called "direct-mail".

2. Upload the whole "direct-mail" folder to your website:
   - cPanel / GoDaddy / Bluehost / Hostinger: File Manager > public_html > Upload, then Extract.
   - FTP: copy the folder into public_html (or www).
   - WordPress: same as above (File Manager or FTP into the folder that holds wp-content).
   The calculator is then live at:  https://YOUR-SITE.com/direct-mail/

3. Show it on a page (optional). Open embed-snippet.html, change YOUR-SITE.com
   to your address, and paste the code into:
   - WordPress: a "Custom HTML" block
   - Wix: Add > Embed Code > Embed HTML
   - Squarespace: a "Code" block
   Or just add a button/menu link to https://YOUR-SITE.com/direct-mail/

   Wix and Squarespace can't host the folder itself. Host it somewhere free
   (GitHub Pages or Netlify), then use that address in the embed code.

4. Check it: open https://YOUR-SITE.com/direct-mail/#check
   It should say "Loaded from: CSV files (data/)".

CHANGING PRICES LATER
Edit the files in direct-mail/data/ in Excel, save as CSV, and upload them
over the old ones.

RIGHT NOW IT IS A DEMO
It shows test prices and sample ZIP codes, and orders are not sent anywhere.
To receive orders, put your Zapier webhook URL in direct-mail/js/config.js
(orderEndpoint).
